spec.description: Steam Gaming: browse your installed Steam games, scan local library, enrich with Steam Store metadata (genres, descriptions, metacritic scores), and track play history.

tools.label: Browse Steam Library
tools.description: Browse your Steam game library with genres, play time, sizes, and metacritic scores.

tools.label: Scan Steam Library
tools.description: Scan local Steam installation for installed games by reading ACF manifest files.

tools.label: Enrich Game Metadata
tools.description: Fetch rich metadata (genres, descriptions, images, metacritic scores) from the Steam Store API for games that haven't been enriched yet.

tools.label: Update Steam Library
tools.description: Incremental scan — check for new games since last scan and update the Cortex with any changes.
